name: C++ Foundations
description: Learn C++ from a first compiled program to classes, memory and the standard library.

lessonNames.l5-value-or-reference: Passing by value or by reference
lessonNames.l10-invariants: Classes that keep their data valid
lessonNames.l13-templates: Writing code once for many types

lessonObjectives.l1-source-to-program: Compile and run a C++ program from the terminal, and read a compiler error.
lessonObjectives.l2-fixed-types: Declare variables with fixed types and see integer overflow happen.
lessonObjectives.l3-branches-and-loops: Write conditionals and loops in C++.
lessonObjectives.l4-functions-and-headers: Write functions and declare them in a header file.
lessonObjectives.l5-value-or-reference: Choose between a copy and a reference for each argument.
lessonObjectives.l6-const: Use `const` on variables, references and methods.
lessonObjectives.l7-addresses: Read and write through a pointer, and see when one dangles.
lessonObjectives.l8-stack-and-heap: Explain object lifetimes on the stack and the heap.
lessonObjectives.l9-owning-memory: Use `std::unique_ptr` and RAII so memory frees itself.
lessonObjectives.l10-invariants: Write a class whose constructor and methods protect an invariant.
lessonObjectives.l11-creation-destruction: Control what happens when an object is created, copied and destroyed.
lessonObjectives.l12-operators: Overload arithmetic operators for a small value type.
lessonObjectives.l16-algorithms: Use `std::sort`, `std::accumulate` and lambdas instead of hand-written loops.
lessonObjectives.l17-cmake: Build a project of several files with CMake.
lessonObjectives.l18-unit-tests: Write unit tests for C++ code with a test framework.
lessonObjectives.l19-moving-not-copying: Explain move semantics, write a move constructor, and say when a move happens.
lessonObjectives.l20-rule-of-five: Decide which special members a class needs and write them correctly.
lessonObjectives.l21-virtual-dispatch: Explain the vtable, object slicing and why a base class needs a virtual destructor.
lessonObjectives.l22-undefined-behaviour: Spot undefined behaviour in short snippets and say what the compiler may do with it.
lessonObjectives.l23-own-smart-pointer: Implement a minimal unique pointer and a reference-counted pointer.
